newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares post small gains at end of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares post small gains at end of settlement.

text.p: Delhi shares reversed course to end higher on Friday as foreign investors bought selective stocks and speculators covered short positions at the end of settlement, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index closed 1.58 points higher at 797.67.
"Multinational company stocks, which attracted sizeable buying from foreign institutional investors, were the main feature of the session," said Naresh Chand of brokers K. Raj Financial Consultants.
Reliance Industries ended 3.25 rupees higher at 298.
State Bank of India gained 9.70 rupees at 317.70.
Larsen and Toubro rose 1.15 rupees to 227.05.
